summary: Direct Camera now follows fast first-person turns, including a full spin on a System Link host. Hosts can also choose how players turn during grenade throws and in midair. This patch corrects playback of original Xbox sounds and fixes fog tracking in split-screen.
highlights: Direct Camera follows your aim through a fast turn on foot, including when your view crosses behind your character.

Player Turning defaults to Stock. Before hosting a match, choose Follow Aim under Edit Gametypes → Performance to let Spartans turn at the map’s normal moving turn speed during grenade throws and in midair. Every player joining an enabled match needs a compatible build.

Xbox audio playback now includes the first sample in each compressed block, correcting a source of periodic buzz. Looping sounds retain their muffling as you move out of range and release their audio channels when you leave a map.
Split-screen fog now tracks each player’s own camera as they look around.
The community assault rifle grenade launcher now centers its loaded ammo count and displays all six ammo indicators in one row.
On Mac, Native Metal reuses prepared drawing work. In a measured campaign scene at native resolution, the CPU spent about 11% less time preparing and encoding frames, with similar frame rates.
